method: Preserves all first-200 P20 priority IDs. Source-snippet inspection and targeted repository cross-check establish site-source evidence for an initial subset; other rows remain explicitly unreviewed. No source snippet alone certifies exact building footprint or physical one-to-one canonical identity.
guards: No new published Place, Shrine, pilgrimage, relic, image, TLM schedule or Directory join in this research pass.
Existing discovery URLs are not automatically reliable matches to the candidate title: flag wrong-site pointers for Gaboltov, Litmanová, Ptujska Gora, Marseille St-Victor and others.
A sanctuary complex may contain separate chapels, basilicas, grottos, tombs and statues; name each physical unit independently before claiming one pin.
Preserve Latin Catholic, Eastern Catholic, Anglican, Orthodox, historical heritage and operating status without pretending they are interchangeable.
Prior reviewed canonical exact matches outrank plausible aliases; no title-only promotion.
Legacy country codes DY (Benin) and HV (Burkina Faso) normalized for source routing without mutating original record IDs.
A cited URL was inspected through retrieved web text excerpts, not asserted to be a completed building-footprint and access review.
September 2026 church sources show distinct old and new Peñafrancia buildings (Naga) and newly dedicated Balasar sanctuary church (Portugal); historical title alone must never geocode the wrong one.
